subject: planner: create index with embedded analyze (#63143)
summary: Reviewed the embedded DDL-analyze plumbing: new sysvar `tidb_enable_ddl_analyze`, job SessionVars propagation, internal restricted-SQL exec option to allow ANALYZE to include `StateWriteReorganization` indexes, and stats DDL/autoanalyze subscribers skipping duplicate work when DDL already analyzed. No remaining Blocker/High issues after checking subsequent history up to `upstream/master` (the only high-impact risk spotted—potential indefinite waiting during embedded analyze—was addressed later via timeout/status handling).
